steps.en: Install the package under the historical name
Pulls the pinned same-version implementation and exposes it as thriftpy
steps.zh: 拉入钉死的同版实现，以 thriftpy 之名提供

steps.en: Point it at your Thrift IDL file
steps.zh: 指向你的 Thrift IDL 文件

steps.en: Parses the IDL with ply and materializes client/server stubs in-process — no codegen step
steps.zh: 以 ply 解析 IDL，就地物化客户端/服务端 stub，免 codegen

steps.en: Stand up the server around your Dispatcher and serve Thrift-wire calls
steps.zh: 把 Dispatcher 包进服务端，应答 Thrift 调用

value.en: Thrift RPC in Python with no build step — and legacy `import thriftpy` code now runs the maintained thriftpy2 engine
value.zh: 免构建步骤的 Thrift RPC——旧 import 名跑的就是维护中的 thriftpy2 引擎
